steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(14); })()

steps.name: stub-share
steps.eval: (() => { window.__shareCalls = []; navigator.canShare = (data) => !!(data && data.files && data.files.length > 0); navigator.share = (data) => { window.__shareCalls.push({ name: data.files?.[0]?.name, type: data.files?.[0]?.type, title: data.title }); return Promise.resolve(); }; })()

steps.name: assert-file-shared
steps.eval: (() => { const call = window.__shareCalls[0]; if (!call) throw new Error('no share call recorded'); if (!call.name || !/^sofa-hero-.*\.png$/.test(call.name)) throw new Error('unexpected shared filename: ' + call.name); if (call.type !== 'image/png') throw new Error('unexpected shared file type: ' + call.type); return true; })()

steps.name: assert-no-share-button
steps.eval: (() => { const buttons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const hasShare = buttons.some((b) => b.textContent && b.textContent.trim().startsWith('Share…')); if (hasShare) throw new Error('Share… button present without navigator.share support'); return true; })()
